title: Level 1: Programming Foundations
description: Learn programming from first principles with Kotlin, then add the software-development habits needed to build, inspect, and improve reliable programs.
plannedTopics: Kotlin syntax, control flow, functions, null safety, and small-program design
Object modelling, sealed outcomes, collections, lambdas, extensions, and scope functions
Exceptions, generics, variance, delegation, inline APIs, value classes, metadata, JVM interop, and memory
Terminal workflows, Git collaboration, debugging, data structures, HTTP, JSON, and capstone delivery

project.title: Kotlin Expense Manager
project.summary: Create a command-line expense manager with validation, persistence, tests, and clean domain models.

theme.mapMood: A clear starting route where every symbol gains a practical meaning.
